problem_type: Batch generation materialized work before user confirmation
symptom: Cancelling the storyboard batch confirmation could leave canvas nodes behind, and a failed reference card could still allow dependent shots to dispatch.
direct_cause: runStoryboardBatch created nodes and dispatched one mixed wave before the spend confirmation owned by confirmAndRunPlan; the reference and shot stages had no shared fail-closed boundary.
class_root: Every paid storyboard batch must derive a checked plan, confirm it before materialization, and gate each dependent wave on the completed result of its prerequisite wave.
affected_population: Storyboard users running remaining or selected shots with visual reference cards
User and Agent initiated storyboard batch runs
entry_points: StoryboardPlanEditor remaining and selected batch actions
Canvas and task-center batch runners that share confirmAndRunPlan
internal_only_reason: The ordering and materialization invariant is owned by this repository's storyboard execution contract.
invariants: A cancelled confirmation creates zero new nodes and dispatches zero waves.
Every storyboard creation entry defers its canvas write to the shared confirmation runner; existing nodes may be regenerated without materialization.
The confirmation checklist is the source of truth for the rows and anchors that are materialized.
Selected visual references dispatch before dependent shots, and a reference failure dispatches no dependent shot wave.

door_reduction.why_not: The shared confirmation runner still has independent canvas and task-center callers, while all storyboard creation and anchor doors now converge on the deferred materialization options of confirmAndRunNode/confirmAndRunPlan; unrelated callers retain their existing contracts.

generality_proof: confirmStoryboardBatch remains the checklist boundary for remaining/selected runs, and confirmAndRunNode/confirmAndRunPlan now own the shared confirmation-to-materialization boundary for single rows, Agent anchor cards, and keyframe rows. Door-map coverage includes both UI and Agent entry points, so cancellation cannot leave a newly created node behind.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Build the refs-first checklist and return only checked rows and anchors after confirmation.
Materialize only after confirmation, dispatch reference waves first, and fail closed before dependent shot dispatch.
Keep the existing spend confirmation and execution guards for each paid wave; storyboard deferred plans materialize only after the card is accepted.
Provide the single confirmation-to-materialization seam for a new storyboard node; existing nodes continue directly to the runner.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The capability calls the same exported storyboard batch owner.
Remaining and selected UI actions both call the shared owner through guardMaterialize.
This canvas table entry is a placement/legacy bridge and does not construct the storyboard remaining checklist; it is covered by the existing confirmAndRunPlan contract.

recurrence.reason: Any new storyboard batch caller could otherwise materialize before confirmation or dispatch dependents after a failed prerequisite.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs runStoryboardBatch confirmStoryboardBatch materializeAnchorCard confirmAndRunPlan

prevention.invariant: No new storyboard node or paid wave exists until its shared confirmation plan is accepted; reference failure prevents shot dispatch.
prevention.failure_mode: Cancellation returns declined before materialization; an unchecked item is omitted; missing reference results return started before shots are dispatched.
prevention.strategy: Keep checklist derivation, selection filtering, reference ordering, and fail-closed dependency gating in the storyboard executor, while making confirmAndRunNode/confirmAndRunPlan the only deferred materialization seam.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old path could materialize and dispatch before the checklist confirmation; it is replaced by the refs-first checked plan path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls the storyboard ordering invariant.

migration: No persisted storyboard data changes. B5b checkbox meaning is handled by the explicit storyboardSelectionMigration boundary for old UI state; the new batch plan is derived at run time.
residual_risks: A provider can accept a reference request and fail before a usable result is observed; the current gate stops dependent shots and leaves the reference node available for retry.
Real Electron UI confirmation and bilingual screenshots remain unverified in this environment.
